01-04: Roll on this table at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute, ignoring this result on later rolls.
05-08: A Friendly creature appears in a random unoccupied space within 60 ft. (1 minute duration). Roll 1d4: 1 = Modron Duodrone, 2 = Flumph, 3 = Modron Monodrone, 4 = Unicorn.
09-12: You regain 5 HP at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute.
13-16: Creatures have Disadvantage on saving throws against the next spell you cast in 1 minute that involves a save.

17-20.effect: You are subjected to a 1-minute effect (unless otherwise stated). Roll 1d8:

table.1: Faint ethereal music surrounds you (only audible within 5 ft).
table.2: Your size increases by one category.
table.3: You grow a feather-beard that explodes off your face when you sneeze.
table.4: You must shout when you speak.
table.5: Illusory butterflies flutter within 10 ft of you.
table.6: An eye appears on your forehead, granting Advantage on Perception checks.
table.7: Pink bubbles float out of your mouth whenever you speak.
table.8: Your skin turns vibrant blue for 24 hours or until Remove Curse.

21-24: For 1 minute, all spells you cast with a casting time of an action instead use a Bonus Action.
25-28: You are transported to the Astral Plane until the end of your next turn, then return to your prior space or nearest unoccupied space.
29-32: The next damaging spell you cast in 1 minute deals maximum possible damage instead of rolling.
33-36: You gain Resistance to all damage for 1 minute.
37-40: You turn into a potted plant until the start of your next turn. You are Incapacitated and Vulnerable to all damage. If reduced to 0 HP, the pot breaks and you revert.
41-44: For 1 minute, you can teleport 20 ft as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.
45-48: You and up to three creatures within 30 ft become Invisible for 1 minute. Ends early if the creature attacks, deals damage, or casts a spell.
49-52: A spectral shield hovers near you for 1 minute, granting +2 AC and immunity to Magic Missile.
53-56: You can take one extra action this turn.

57-60.effect: You cast a random spell (no Concentration required). Roll 1d10:

table.4: Fly (on a random creature within 60 ft)
table.9: Polymorph (on yourself; may turn into a Goat on a failed save)

61-64: For 1 minute, any flammable nonmagical object you touch ignites (1d4 Fire damage).
65-68: If you die within the next hour, you revive immediately as if by Reincarnate.
69-72: You are Frightened until the end of your next turn (DM chooses source of fear).
73-76: You teleport up to 60 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.
77-80: A random creature within 60 ft is Poisoned for 1d4 hours.
81-84: You radiate Bright Light in 30 ft for 1 minute. Any creature ending its turn within 5 ft is Blinded until end of its next turn.
85-88: Up to three creatures within 30 ft take 1d10 Necrotic damage and you regain HP equal to the total dealt.
89-92: Up to three creatures within 30 ft take 4d10 Lightning damage.
93-96: You and all creatures within 30 ft have Vulnerability to Piercing damage for 1 minute.

table.2: One ally within 300 ft regains 2d10 HP.
table.3: You regain your lowest-level expended spell slot.
table.4: One ally within 300 ft regains their lowest-level expended spell slot.
table.5: You regain all expended Sorcery Points.
table.6: All effects from row 17–20 apply to you simultaneously.
